runs.name: Centuri Holdings, Inc.; CTRI, SEC CIK 0001981599, 10-K filer, fiscal year ended 2025-12-28; a North American utility and energy infrastructure services contractor, crews and equipment for electric and gas distribution and transmission work under MSAs and bids, four segments (U.S. Gas, Non-Union Electric, Union Electric, Canadian Operations); carved out of Southwest Gas Holdings by the IPO of April 2024, the former parent's last shares sold 2025-09-05; Icahn Group director agreement 2025-11-10; 7,441,860 shares sold at $21.50 in November 2025; new CFO 2026-08-12; the 10-K names five national rivals, Quanta, MYR Group and Primoris compared, MasTec and Everus not read
runs.entry: Price **$19.73** (close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged). Shares **100,963,053** common on the cover of the Q2 2026 10-Q (0001981599-26-000089; `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing, balance sheet 100,956,691), one class; market cap $1,992.0M. Sovereign **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (issuing authority). Read from the FY2025 10-K (0001981599-26-000020), the FY2024 10-K, the Q2 2026 10-Q, the 2026 proxy, the 424B4 of 2024-04-18 (0001193125-24-100835) for FY2021 to FY2023, Southwest Gas Holdings' FY2020 and FY2018 annual-report exhibits for FY2016 to FY2020, and the recent 8-Ks; lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file; operating cash and capital spending cross-checked to the filed cash-flow statement. **Q1 IN**: utility labor sold to utilities that supply their own materials, 78% of revenue under MSAs, ten years of statements read. **Q2 OUT**: the castle shown open on the filer's own Item 1A words ("Relatively few barriers prevent entry", customers "generally require competitive bidding", rivals "may also have lower overhead cost structures", most MSAs cancellable on about thirty days), capped escalators and Q2 2026 fuel costs not passed on; the deciding part U.S. Gas, the largest at 36.8% of FY2022 to FY2025 gross profit, gross margin 6.4%, 9.1%, 5.5%, 5.4% and 4.2% in Q2 2026; operating margin 5.2% (FY2016 to FY2020) to 3.6% (FY2021 to FY2025) while Quanta's (4.7% to 5.5%), MYR Group's (3.1% to 3.6%) and Primoris's (4.3% to 4.9%) rose; owner cash after all spending 0.4% of revenue against the rivals' 2.0% to 3.8%; the field protects only ordinary returns, OUT not TOO HARD. Riggs Distler bought for $822.2M in 2021, $391.1M of goodwill written off 2022 to 2023. Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash **$94.0M a year** all-equity maintenance-only (central), $36.4M after all spending, FY2021 to FY2025 averages with the one-time $125.0M first receivables sale (FY2024) and the $37.8M sale-leaseback (FY2025) taken out; equity-only $46.2M and -$11.4M; best case 3.42% at the price, 4.93% counting Riggs Distler's part-year as growth; value range **-$0.82 to $9.68 a share all-equity (central)**, net debt $753.3M with the $62M JJ White purchase; equity-only -$2.07 to $8.43; fair price **-$1.01 all-equity**, not positive, $1.72 equity-only. Balance sheets: only four full year-ends filed for the carve-out (declared); retained earnings $205.6M to -$128.4M, equity raised by the IPO, the November 2025 offering and tax attributes from the former parent; receivables and contract assets 23.8% of revenue, contract assets up 67% in FY2025 on 13% revenue growth; debt about $1.24B down to $732M while $165M of receivables sold and $197.5M of operating leases rose; pre-tax earnings covered interest 1.19x in FY2025 and 0.96x in FY2024. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: guidance on adjusted figures (Q2 2026 Adjusted Net Income $24.4M against GAAP $6.1M), recurring "non-recurring" add-backs, a City of Chicago receivable for pre-2020 work written off for $9.0M in 2026 after the claim was denied in 2024, four CEOs in 2024, the CFO and chief legal officer replaced in August 2026. Strongest evidence against: the filer says entry is easy and customers buy on the bid; its margin narrowed while every rival's widened; revenue turned into almost no cash; interest about equal to operating income. Commits 914be484 (template), 9e40af46 (Step 0), 2470e8fe (Q1), 8a86c984 (Q2), 03955ebd (box, computation, after the stop, self-audit, gaps). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Contamination declared: the session's opening git status and recent commit subjects (another company's fold), the memory index lines and a count of files in `Test Runs/`, none used. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` 48 ids, 12 quoted fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` no missing id, 17 adjacent quoted fragments, 5 flagged and all read: filing quotes (Item 1A, the proxy, the tax note, "non-recurring") or a fragment broken across a line, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) Q4's eight to ten years of balance sheets for a 2024 carve-out with four filed year-ends, and whether the parent's segment notes count; (2) a sale of receivables to a securitization facility under Q7 (d), taken out of owner cash and shown beside net debt; (3) (e)'s maintenance guess while the fleet moves to operating leases; (4) the serial-acquirer organic pair when the filer reports no organic growth; (5) the rate for the interest add-back on the all-equity basis and Whose tax when only some carryforwards expire inside ten years. Could not get: balance sheets before FY2022 beyond the former parent's total assets; a filed organic growth figure; the tax-carryforward adjustment (could only lower the figures). Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (Centuri Holdings, Inc., CTRI; utility infrastructure services contractor carved out of Southwest Gas in 2024; Q1 IN; Q2 OUT on the filer's own words, few barriers to entry, competitive bidding, cheaper rivals, MSAs cancellable on thirty days, U.S. Gas deciding at 36.8% of four-year gross profit with gross margin falling to 4.2%, operating margin 5.2% to 3.6% while Quanta, MYR Group and Primoris rose; integrity facts recorded, not judged: adjusted-figure guidance, a $9.0M Chicago receivable carried after denial, four CEOs in 2024; computation only: owner cash $94.0M a year all-equity maintenance-only, value range -$0.82 to $9.68, fair -$1.01 all-equity, $1.72 equity-only; no citation slip; not held; not armed; framework gaps for the operator: a carve-out's short balance-sheet record, receivables securitization under (d), maintenance during a shift to leases, no filed organic growth, the interest add-back rate)
